subject: Request: validate service gap, credit eligibility, and retroactive exception
messages:
From: Jake Miller <jmiller@northbridge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ops@northbridge.com
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 22:10:00 -0700
Subject: Service interruption on 2028-10-04 — request for validation and remedy

Hi Aditya,

We observed an unusual availability gap affecting our checkout flow this evening between ~2028-10-04T21:36Z and 2028-10-04T21:53Z (approx). During that window we saw a high rate of 500s and repeated 429s across multiple regions; our internal telemetry shows ~1.8% errors at peak which materially impacted transactions.

Can you confirm whether this maps to any platform-level outage or routing fallback on Redwood's side, and whether this incident qualifies for SLA credit per our contract? We need:
- Confirmation of any service interruption or degraded routing for our tenant
- The official start/end times you have on record
- The path to request a retroactive exception or credit if eligible

I've attached a small bundle with an excerpt of our client-side traces and a few request IDs. If you can expedite, we have a renewal review happening next week and we'd like this cleared in advance.

Attachments: northbridge_logs_20281004.zip (contains trace-snippet-20281004.txt)

Thanks,
Jake Miller
Head of Platform Ops — Northbridge Payments
jmiller@northbridge.com
+1 415 555 0123

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Jake Miller <jmiller@northbridge.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 22:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service interruption on 2028-10-04 — request for validation and remedy

Hi Jake — thanks for the heads up and for sending the logs. Sorry for the disruption. We'll treat this as an SLA eligibility request and start evidence collection immediately. Quick summary of next steps from our side: 

1) Can you confirm the exact request IDs you want us to correlate (we received a bundle but a short list of 5–10 canonical IDs helps).
2) We'll pull ingress metrics, routing fallback events, and autoscaler traces for your tenant across the reported window.
3) If the evidence shows a platform-side availability regression, we'll calculate credit eligibility per section 4.2 of the contract and provide a remediation plan and postmortem.

For transparency, our timeline: infra will pull raw traces and metrics tonight and we aim to provide an initial impact window confirmation by EOD (PST). Product will own a postmortem within 3 business days unless the case requires extended analysis.

If you prefer a dedicated bridge, Laura is standing by to coordinate.

Best,
Aditya Rao
Head of Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference
aditya_rao@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com, sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 4 Oct 2028 23:08:00 -0700
Subject: [Internal] Evidence pull checklist — Northbridge incident

[Internal] quick runbook for the team — attaching the runbook template. Please don't forward internal notes to the customer.

Items to collect tonight:
- Ingress request counts and 5xx/429 rates (per-AZ) for tenant NB-4321 from 2028-10-04T21:20Z to 2028-10-04T22:10Z
- Router logs for all edges that served NB requests (grep by tenant id and the provided request ids)
- KV-cache eviction events and any cold-start/quantization fallback logs
- Autoscaler events (scale-up/scale-down) and any OOM/eviction signals on GPUs
- Per-request latency tail percentiles (p50/p95/p99) and whether any batching windows were aborted

Deliverables: short timeline (start/end), raw trace bundle (s3 link), initial eligibility recommendation.

I will own the trace collection and assemble the initial timeline. Sean, can you review whether our routing fallback policy kicked in and whether we should mark this as a regional routing incident?

Thanks — Laury
Laura Bennett, Sr. Manager, Incident Response

Attachment: rca-runbook-template.md

From: Jake Miller <jmiller@northbridge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: ops@northbridge.com
Date: Fri, 5 Oct 2028 09:35:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Service interruption on 2028-10-04 — request for validation and remedy

Aditya — thanks for the quick reply and to Laura for coordinating. Per your request, attached is a concise list of 8 representative request IDs and a small excerpt of client-side traces. We also included our internal timeline.

Request IDs: 7d8a2f1c, 7d8a2f1d, 7d8a2f2a, 7d8a3b4f, 7d8a3b50, 7d8a3c01, 7d8a3c02, 7d8a3c10

We appreciate an expedited confirmation of: (a) the exact start/end times you see on your side, (b) whether this meets the threshold for SLA remedy, and (c) the process for submitting a retroactive exception / credit if eligible.

Attachments included: northbridge_logs_20281004.zip, trace-snippet-20281004.txt, support-case-84721.pdf

Thanks,
Jake
